purpose: Revalidate the already-frozen A01 cancellation/release repair on the current integrated tree after main advanced.
scope: Host-side deterministic fake-display regression and source-integrity replay only; no live input, X server, GUI, game, model, or allocation.

decision.pass: All six named suites exit 0 with the frozen case counts, and the raw-only auditor validates their retained outputs and source tree pins.
decision.fail: Any nonzero suite exit, count mismatch, missing output, source pin mismatch, or audit mismatch.
